description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM models and functions for managing permissions, views, roles, and permission view mappings in a database schema related to security and access control within the Superset project. It includes classes for Permission, ViewMenu, Role, PermissionView, and functions for adding, finding, migrating, and deleting permission-related entities.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Represents a permission entity with a unique name.

classes.name: ViewMenu
classes.description: Represents a view menu entity with a unique name.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role with associated permissions.

classes.name: Pvm
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a permission view mapping with view and permission strings.

methods.name: _add_view_menu
methods.description: Checks if a view menu exists by name; if not, creates and adds it.

methods.name: _add_permission
methods.description: Checks if a permission exists by name; if not, creates and adds it.

methods.name: _add_permission_view
methods.description: Checks if a permission view exists for given permission and view; if not, creates and adds it.

methods.name: _find_pvm
methods.description: Finds a PermissionView by view name and permission name.

methods.name: add_pvms
methods.description: Adds multiple permission view mappings based on provided data, optionally commits.

methods.name: _delete_old_permissions
methods.description: Deletes old permission view mappings and orphaned permissions/views.

methods.name: migrate_roles
methods.description: Migrates roles' permissions from old to new permission view mappings, optionally commits.

methods.name: get_reversed_new_pvms
methods.description: Reverses a permission view mapping to group permissions by view.

methods.name: get_reversed_pvm_map
methods.description: Reverses a permission view mapping to associate new permission views with old ones.
